{"verses":[{"text":"For God strictly commanded those who came, even as they came, what they should do to live, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.","chapter":7,"verse":21},{"text":"Nevertheless, they weren’t obedient to him, but spoke against him and imagined for themselves vain things.","chapter":7,"verse":22},{"text":"They made cunning plans of wickedness, and said moreover of the Most High that he doesn’t exist, and they didn’t know his ways.","chapter":7,"verse":23},{"text":"They despised his law and denied his covenants. They haven’t been faithful to his statutes, and haven’t performed his works.","chapter":7,"verse":24},{"text":"Therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.","chapter":7,"verse":25},{"text":"For behold, the time will come, and it will be, when these signs of which I told you before will come to pass, that the bride will appear, even the city coming forth, and she will be seen who now is withdrawn from the earth.","chapter":7,"verse":26},{"text":"Whoever is delivered from the foretold evils will see my wonders.","chapter":7,"verse":27},{"text":"For my son Jesus will be revealed with those who are with him, and those who remain will rejoice four hundred years.","chapter":7,"verse":28},{"text":"After these years my son Christ will die, along with all of those who have the breath of life.","chapter":7,"verse":29},{"text":"Then the world will be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the first beginning, so that no human will remain.","chapter":7,"verse":30},{"text":"After seven days the world that is not yet awake will be raised up, and what is corruptible will die.","chapter":7,"verse":31},{"text":"The earth will restore those who are asleep in it, and the dust those who dwell in it in silence, and the secret places will deliver those souls that were committed to them.","chapter":7,"verse":32},{"text":"The Most High will be revealed on the judgment seat, and compassion will pass away, and patience will be withdrawn.","chapter":7,"verse":33},{"text":"Only judgment will remain. Truth will stand. Faith will grow strong.","chapter":7,"verse":34},{"text":"Recompense will follow. The reward will be shown. Good deeds will awake, and wicked deeds won’t sleep.","chapter":7,"verse":35},{"text":"The pit of torment will appear, and near it will be the place of rest. The furnace of hellwill be shown, and near it the paradise of delight.","chapter":7,"verse":36},{"text":"Then the Most High will say to the nations that are raised from the dead, ‘Look and understand whom you have denied, whom you haven’t served, whose commandments you have despised.","chapter":7,"verse":37},{"text":"Look on this side and on that. Here is delight and rest, and there fire and torments.’ Thus he will speak to them in the day of judgment.","chapter":7,"verse":38},{"text":"This is a day that has neither sun, nor moon, nor stars,","chapter":7,"verse":39},{"text":"neither cloud, nor thunder, nor lightning, neither wind, nor water, nor air, neither darkness, nor evening, nor morning,","chapter":7,"verse":40}],"chapter":7,"book_code":"2ES"}
